brief:
Drop Site News assembled financial expert Brett Erickson alongside hosts Murtaza Hussain and Ryan Grim to examine mounting instability in the Strait of Hormuz and the economic implications of rising regional tensions. The discussion focused on risks to global shipping and oil markets tied to the strategic waterway, a chokepoint for international commerce.

The program also featured media analyst Sharif Abdel Kouddous and Palestinian journalist Abubaker Abed in a separate segment documenting the deaths of journalists in Gaza during the ongoing conflict. The conversation centered on the hazards faced by news workers operating in active conflict zones and the impact on press freedom in the territory.
dek: Financial expert Brett Erickson joins Drop Site's Murtaza Hussain and Ryan Grim followed by Sharif Abdel Kouddous and Palestinian journalist Abubaker Abed.
title: Drop Site convenes experts on Hormuz tensions and Gaza journalist deaths
